title: DICOM → NIfTI
description: Scans a DICOM folder or file, selects series with the analyzers, converts them to NIfTI with DICOM JSON sidecars, and imports the rows (DICOM_CONVERTER.md).

target_profile.x-help: Organ focus used to rank series (analyzer.target)

skip_unsafe_geometry.x-help: Skip series with irregular spacing, gaps or several stacks (DCM-03)

sidecars.x-help: One DICOM JSON sidecar per converted series (DCM-04)

anonymize.x-help: basic: PS3.15 Basic Profile subset on sidecars and rows; patient_id becomes the case id (DCM-05)
